sourceCurriculum: Interleaved Cross-Domain Synthesis (OpenStax Prealgebra 2e & Geometry Foundations)

archetypes.name: Box Surface Geodesic vs Space Diagonal Synthesis
archetypes.coreConcept: A cable or crawler must travel along the faces of a rectangular box between opposite corners. No formula is given: the solver unfolds the box into each of the three possible flat nets, finds the straight-line length on each, picks the shortest, compares it with the (unreachable) space diagonal, and reports exact simplest radicals plus a decimal bound.
archetypes.mentalModel: 1. Recognize that a path on the faces becomes a straight segment once two adjacent faces are unfolded flat. 2. Build the three nets; each gives a right triangle with legs (sum of two dimensions, third dimension). 3. Compute and simplify all three radicals, then choose the minimum. 4. Compare with the space diagonal sqrt(w^2 + l^2 + h^2) and round only at the end.

archetypes.name: Annulus & Inscribed Radical Metric Synthesis
archetypes.coreConcept: Compute concentric circular boundaries with exact radical chords, expressing area and perimeter differences under specified decimal tolerance.
archetypes.mentalModel: Pythagorean chord tangent to inner boundary generating exact radical radius difference.

archetypes.name: Frustum Volume by Cone Completion & Radical Flow Metric
archetypes.coreConcept: A truncated conical reservoir is given by its two radii and vertical height, with no frustum volume formula. The solver completes the frustum to a full cone with similar triangles, subtracts the removed apex cone, finds the slant height as an exact radical, and converts the volume into a fill time under a decimal flow rate.
archetypes.mentalModel: 1. Draw the axial cross-section and extend the slanted sides to the apex. 2. Use similar triangles H / R = (H - h) / r to find the full-cone height H. 3. Subtract the small cone from the full cone to get the reservoir volume. 4. Find the slant sqrt(h^2 + (R - r)^2) in simplest radical form, then divide the volume by the flow rate and round last.
